resources.string: Delete all transcriptions from this phone?
Transcriptions of incoming voice messages appear here. You can also share a voice message from WhatsApp to this app.
Voice messages are waiting: open the app and download a model in Settings.
A voice message arrived on %1$s, but the app cannot read its voice notes folder. Open the app and choose the folder.
The model could not be loaded (corrupted file or not enough memory)
Stopped by the system three times; tap Transcribe again to retry
The downloaded file is damaged: download it again
The folder permission could not be kept: choose the folder again
Folder saved, but it does not look like a voice notes folder: check that it ends with \"Voice Notes\"
Enable notification access, so the app knows when a voice message arrives.
If notification access is greyed out (\"restricted setting\"): open App info, menu ⋮, \"Allow restricted settings\", then come back.
Choose the %1$s voice notes folder (the picker opens on it: tap \"Use this folder\").
Remove battery restrictions, so transcriptions finish in the background. On OPPO, OnePlus, realme and Xiaomi phones also allow background activity and auto-launch in the app\'s battery settings.
Larger models are more accurate and slower. The model stays on the phone; audio never leaves it.
Processor cores used while the app is on screen. Usually all cores is fastest.
Cores used in the background. Some phones (OPPO, OnePlus, realme) stop an app that keeps every core busy while you use the phone: keep this low.
While you use the phone, Android and the manufacturer\'s system can stop the app in the middle of a transcription. These permissions are needed.
Removed: the app can work in the background.
Active: Android can stop the app from working in the background.
A ColorOS setting the app cannot check. On the page that opens, tap \"Battery usage\" and turn on \"Allow background activity\".
A MIUI setting the app cannot check. On the page that opens, tap \"Battery saver\" and choose \"No restrictions\".
On the same page, turn on \"Allow auto launch\".
On the page that opens, turn on auto-start for the app.
Last problem: %1$s the system stopped the voice message from %2$s three times.
No problems in the last 7 days.
Voice messages are transcribed, but while you use the phone a transcription can stop halfway. Tap to remove the restrictions.
The voice message from %1$s (%2$s) was stopped three times while I was transcribing it. This usually depends on the phone\'s battery settings.
The voice message from %1$s was stopped three times while I was transcribing it. This usually depends on the phone\'s battery settings.
%1$s the system stopped a transcription. Check the permissions for background work.

The folder is Android/media/com.whatsapp/WhatsApp/Media/WhatsApp Voice Notes (for WhatsApp Business: com.whatsapp.w4b/WhatsApp Business/Media/WhatsApp Business Voice Notes). Voice messages already in the folder are not transcribed automatically.
